summary: WorksheetAssignInstructors is a web user control for assigning instructors to worksheet groups in the context of placements and education scheduling. It supports both individual and group assignment modes, filtering, paging, and workflow operations, including editing, moving, and excluding groups or entries, with a variety of filter controls and status indicators.
purpose: To facilitate searching, filtering, displaying, and assigning instructors (including editing and moving) to worksheet groups or individual worksheet assignments within an educational placement system. The control supports user interactions, business logic, and actions to assign, move, exclude, or edit instructors for placement groups based on a wide range of criteria.

workflows.name: Assign Instructor(s) to Worksheet Group
steps: User selects filter criteria (instructor, site, date, etc.)
Data is bound to dropdowns and controls (filtered lists)
Worksheet group tally is generated and displayed
User can select rows via checkboxes
User clicks Edit or Edit All to redirect to edit mode
Selected instructor(s) are assigned via update method
Changes are saved and view refreshed

workflows.name: Move Worksheet Entries
steps: User selects worksheet entries (via checkboxes)
User chooses target timetable from dropdown
User initiates move action
Entries are moved to selected timetable
UI and session state updated, warning message shown if moved

workflows.name: Exclude/Include From Placement Requests
steps: User clicks exclude/include icons for a group
PlacementRequestDestinations logic is executed to update exclusion
View is refreshed

workflows.name: Paging and Filtering
steps: User toggles paging or filters
Session variables are set for current filters
UI is updated with new filtered/paged data

workflows.name: Totals and Status Calculation
steps: Setup totals for assigned, available, remaining, etc.
Totals shown in headers/footers depending on group or individual mode
Status indicators updated (including NotAvailable, ledger classes)

business_rules: Instructor dropdowns are hidden if a Site Instructor exists or is requested
Edit buttons are disabled if Placement Requests exist (unless sysadmin/coordinator)
Exclusion from placement requests is only available if ASM is enabled, user is admin, and student pref/matching is allowed
Totals are calculated based on mode (GroupFlag) and block status
Session variables must be set/reset before redirect or refresh
Not available groups/entries are visually hidden and counted for UI purposes
validations: Check for valid uuid and integer values in parameters
Ensure instructor IDs are parsed and non-zero before assignment
Cancellation of edit if UserSession is null
Proper selection of dropdown values based on session/filters
calculations: Totals for group count, available, assigned, remaining, filtered and unfiltered
Alternating row logic for class assignment (ledger/NotAvailAlt etc.)
Move count for entries moved between timetables
conditions: GroupFlag determines mode (group vs individual worksheet)
If Placement Requests exist or user role is not sufficient, edit/exclusion actions are limited
Blocks determine UI display and totals
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields are moved from designer to code-behind
Controls and panel visibility are managed based on user role and group/individual mode
Actions result in page redirects, refreshes, or UI updates
Script variables are dynamically generated for client-side JS
dependencies: WorksheetAssignedInstructors, PlacementRequestDestinations, TimetableEntries controllers for business logic
Session variables for maintaining state across actions
exceptions: Edit canceled if UserSession is null
Invalid IDs or filter values are ignored or defaulted
Controls hidden or disabled if conditions not met
